title: vtc-server: opt-in conditional with streamKey/streamUri unreadable marks
description:
Design: docs/design/conditional.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: C9f. Crates: jmap-vtc-server. Size: M.

Apply the C7 pattern (docs/design/conditional.md §5.1, §6, §7; conditional-02 §9.1; decision 1 in docs/design/DECISIONS.md). register_vtc_conditional; register_vtc_handlers unchanged; VTCLivestream/get marks redacted streamKey/streamUri with HandlerOutput::with_unreadable; memory on ScopedState with the event queue in Inner (rollback drops events; delivery deferred to commit) + ConditionalBackend; Atomic final-state: participant alreadyExists, caps. Acceptance: precondition on streamKey for a non-moderator -> forbidden; atomic rollback emits no event; final-state test; public-api additions only.
